documentation_tip: final documentation/evidence commit is intentionally not self-referenced
scope: Split the ordinary FP round-pack leading-one/zero scan and derived exponent from the following tiny classification/normalization stages with a real pack_scan register boundary, while preserving raw IEEE bits, FPCR/FPSR behavior, packed-half lanes and single-outstanding control semantics.

timing_source.report_context: R17 post-fit directional report; physical improvement is not claimed by this owner lane

implementation.summary: Added fp_round_scan_t/round_pack_scan and pack_scan{,_lo,_hi} registers. Ordinary pp_pre now crosses IT_PREP -> IT_PACK_SCAN -> IT_PACK_PRE -> IT_PACK; the scan and exp2+lead metadata are registered before round_pack_pre tiny classification. DIV/SQRT remains on div_pre/sqrt_pre -> IT_FIN -> IT_PACK.

state_boundary.IT_PREP: round_pack_scan(pp_pre*) writes pack_scan*; no result or iter_done
state_boundary.IT_PACK_SCAN: round_pack_pre(pack_scan*) writes pack_pre* and performs only tiny/normal classification; no result or iter_done
state_boundary.IT_PACK_PRE: round_pack_p1(pack_pre*) writes pack_mid* with normalize/GRS; no result or iter_done
state_boundary.IT_PACK: round_pack_p2(pack_mid*) performs final increment/overflow/subnormal/FZ/AHP/pack and exposes iter_done/result
state_boundary.iterative_div_sqrt: No IT_PACK_SCAN visit; existing div_pre/sqrt_pre -> IT_FIN -> IT_PACK path and nominal latency retained
state_boundary.reset_kill: Reset and iter_kill return IT_IDLE and clear pack_scan*, pack_pre*, pack_mid* and prior non-architectural payloads
state_boundary.valid_drop: IT_PREP, IT_PACK_SCAN, IT_PACK_PRE and IT_PACK drop to IT_IDLE without iter_done and clear their round-pack payloads
state_boundary.pause: !iter_pause gates all state transitions; scan/classification/normalization payloads are held and live operands are not re-read
state_boundary.kill_priority: iter_kill is evaluated before iter_pause, so kill clears a paused payload
state_boundary.architectural_commit: No public interface, core, response ownership, commit order or architectural state path changed

latency.pause: paused cycles are additive and excluded from nominal latency

semantics.raw_bits: round_pack_p2 and special/zero/NaN/overflow/subnormal paths are unchanged; only payload timing is extended
semantics.flags: input_flags, FPSR IOC/DZC/OFC/UFC/IXC/IDC, DN/FZ/FZ16/AHP and RMode metadata are carried unchanged
semantics.packed_half: pack_scan_lo/hi and pack_pre_lo/hi are captured in parallel; FCVT remains single-lane
